name: HiCrack
description: Supplemental Materials (Tables S1–S7) for the manuscript “HiCrack: A Hierarchical Crack Benchmark for Marine-Conditioned Plain and Reinforced Recycled-Fiber Concrete Beams under Progressive Flexural Loading,” submitted to the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering. The tables report box geometry by crack class, AP by COCO size band, per-box error types, the label-granularity ablation, the resolution ablation, the augmentation ablation, and crack multiplicity by material and load step.
